title: Long exact sequence of Ext of modules in the second variable
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M$ an $R$-module and $0\to N'\xrightarrow{u}N\xrightarrow{v}N''\to0$ a short exact sequence of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. For $i\ge0$ write $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,-)$ for the $i$-th Ext group $\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$ of [def-pc-ext] in the abelian category $\mathcal A$ of $R$-modules, with the maps $u_*:\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N')\to\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N)$ and $v_*:\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N)\to\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N'')$ given by composition with $u$ and $v$. Then there are homomorphisms $\delta^i:\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N'')\to\operatorname{Ext}^{i+1}_R(M,N')$ ($i\ge0$) such that the sequence $$0\to\operatorname{Ext}^0_R(M,N')\xrightarrow{u_*}\operatorname{Ext}^0_R(M,N)\xrightarrow{v_*}\operatorname{Ext}^0_R(M,N'')\xrightarrow{\delta^0}\operatorname{Ext}^1_R(M,N')\xrightarrow{u_*}\operatorname{Ext}^1_R(M,N)\xrightarrow{v_*}\operatorname{Ext}^1_R(M,N'')\xrightarrow{\delta^1}\operatorname{Ext}^2_R(M,N')\to\cdots$$ is exact; that is, $u_*$ is injective in degree $0$, and for every $i\ge0$ the sequence $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N')\to\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N)\to\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N'')\to\operatorname{Ext}^{i+1}_R(M,N')\to\operatorname{Ext}^{i+1}_R(M,N)$ is exact at its three inner terms.
